benchmarks.label: Brent

peak.note: Futures intraday wartime high (Wikipedia chronology). Physical Dated Brent (EIA spot via FRED) peaked at $138.21 on 2026-04-07 and was $114.89 on 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.note: Brent (January contract) settled down $1.13 (1.2%) at $95.44/bbl on 27 Nov in a holiday-shortened session (CNBC, citing Reuters), but posted its first weekly gain in November, up about 3%, as the market continued pricing in the Houthi strike that killed a worker and halted some operations at Aramco's Jazan refinery on 26 Nov and continuing Hormuz-area attacks; week_ago is the 20 Nov settlement, roughly $92.69 (Political, citing Reuters).

source.name: CNBC — Brent oil posts weekly gain on Middle East supply fears

benchmarks.note: WTI settled at $83.08/bbl on 27 Nov, down 60 cents (0.7%) from the 25 Nov close (no Thursday settlement for the US Thanksgiving holiday), per CNBC. CNBC separately reported WTI down 0.4% on the week; no outlet found this run gave the 20 Nov settlement directly, so week_ago, ~$83.41, is implied from that weekly change rather than independently sourced.
